name: Castaways
source:
You play as Lily, a young highschool girl setting out on a sailing trip with her friends in the Tropics. When a storm suddenly strikes, you are thrown overboard and washed up on a deserted island. Stranded, you must help your group fend off the island's dangers and try to make it home. Maybe you'll even find love along the way with one of these other castaways...?

[From [url=https://tibault.itch.io/castaways]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演年轻的高中女生莉莉，与朋友们一同前往热带海域展开帆船之旅。不料风暴突袭，你落入海中，被冲上了一座荒岛。受困于此的你必须协助同伴抵御岛上的重重危机，设法重返家园。说不定在这一路上，你还会与其他落难者擦出爱情的火花……？

[引自[url=https://tibault.itch.io/castaways]itch.io[/url]]
